learning_objective: 🎯 We will understand how humans, animals, and plants all help each other to live happily in our beautiful world!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Plants are amazing helpers! They give us sweet fruits to eat, cool shade on sunny days, and fresh, clean air so we can breathe easily.
Animals do so much for us. Cows give us healthy milk to drink, sheep give us warm wool for winter, and dogs help guard our homes safely!
Nobody can live all alone. Plants need animals, animals need plants, and humans need both of them! We all hold hands to make the world work.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Thank You, Nature!
fun_activity.instructions: Draw a big circle. On one side draw a plant, and on the other side draw an animal. Draw arrows showing how they give us food!

quick_recap: ⭐ Plants give us our daily food and clean air to breathe.
⭐ Animals help us by giving milk, wool, and keeping us safe.
⭐ Everything in nature is connected and depends on each other to live.
